lane.name: Pick & Pack
lane.description: Pick, pack and ship one sales order: confirm the order and wave, pick the remaining lines, pack at PACK-01 and ship with tracking. One run per sales order. A short or damaged pick goes to the Warehouse Manager for review. The run_data.set write used by the damage approval is provisional, demo only — it is not an Action Type in the core.

fields.description: Reason a unit was damaged, per order line, entered at step 1.2. Keyed by line id.
Number of parcels, entered at step 3.1.
Weighed weight of the parcels in kg, entered at step 3.1, e.g. 1.2.
Tracking number, entered at step 4.1. Suggested as the next number in the carrier's sequence.
Why the pick is held, entered at step 1B.2 when the manager rejects the discrepancy.

Set by the Warehouse Manager approving a short or damaged pick at 1B.1. The pick check passes a line whose damage was approved — the damaged unit stays on the line and is dispositioned by the Count Lane, not erased.

steps.name: Confirm order & wave
steps.description: Confirm the order, customer, wave and route before picking. The Picking Agent has planned the wave; the picker confirms.

steps.name: Pick the remaining lines
steps.description: Pick the remaining lines from their bins. Enter the total picked per line and any damaged units with the reason. Lines already fully picked are shown, not re-picked.

validation.message: Picked must not exceed reserved for this line.

steps.name: Pick check
steps.description: Automatic check: every line fully picked, and nothing damaged — unless the manager already approved the damage at 1B.1. If any line is short or damaged-and-unapproved, the run branches to manager review instead of continuing to pack.

check.message: A line is short or has damaged units the manager has not approved.

steps.name: Review short pick / damage
steps.description: The Warehouse Manager sees per-line ordered vs reserved vs picked vs damaged, with the picker's note. Approve: the damage is marked approved, the picking re-opens as In progress and the run returns to the pick step to pick a replacement from the same bin. Reject: the run goes to the hold step; nothing is packed or shipped.

steps.name: Record hold
steps.description: Record why the pick is held. Completing this step ends the run as held. Nothing is packed or shipped for this order. Resuming the pick is a new run on the same SO.

steps.name: Post pick moves
steps.description: Post a PICK StockMove per order line for what this run picked (MV-2026-020 for SO-2026-002). Runs once per order line. Only the quantity picked in this run is posted — lines already picked before the run are not re-posted. The ledger is append-only.

steps.name: Close the pick
steps.description: Close the pick: the picking is done and the order is picked. This step replaces the wf-wh-04 pack task — the lane packs in Stage 3, so no duplicate task is created. The workflow stays the fallback for a picking that becomes DONE outside a lane.

steps.name: Pack the order
steps.description: At PACK-01: parcels and weighed weight, entered by the packer. The Packing & Shipping Agent proposes the parcel split; the packer confirms or changes it.

steps.name: Post pack moves
steps.description: Post a PACK StockMove per order line (MV-2026-021, MV-2026-022 for SO-2026-002). Runs once per order line. The packed quantity follows the picked quantity.

steps.name: Create shipment & pack
steps.description: Create the shipment (SHIP-2026-013 for SO-2026-002) and mark the order PACKED. This step replaces the wf-wh-05 shipment task — the lane created the shipment here, so no duplicate task is created. The workflow stays the fallback for an order that becomes PACKED outside a lane.

steps.name: Confirm carrier & tracking
steps.description: Carrier and service from the order; the tracking number is carrier-assigned. The demo suggests the next number in the carrier's sequence.

steps.name: Post ship moves
steps.description: Post a SHIP StockMove per order line (MV-2026-023, MV-2026-024 for SO-2026-002). Shipping removes the goods from the warehouse: on hand falls and the reservation is released. Runs once per order line.

steps.name: Ship & close
steps.description: Ship the order: the shipment is marked shipped with its tracking, the order closes as SHIPPED, and the customer and the Warehouse Manager are notified automatically.
